github.copilot.chat.codeGeneration.instr.text: MANDATORY: Before writing ANY UI code with state, STOP and answer these questions OUT LOUD in your response: 1a) What state exists? 1b) Who owns each piece of state? (Must be ViewModel, NEVER View) 1c) How does data flow? (ViewModel → View via binding, NEVER pull from View to ViewModel). If you cannot answer these correctly, do not write code.
